text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board. This report recommends one candidate for appointment to the board.

North York Community Council : 1. Appointed Jeffrey Schwartz to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 30, 2029, and until a successor is appointed. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 14, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Gardens Arena.
